facts.fact: Kay 已预约死马惩教所，想去了解 Deirdre Gregory 服刑期间、尤其是最后一天的情形
facts.anchor: an appointment at the Dead Horse Correctional Facility

facts.fact: 叙述者一路数着新闻车，此时已有七辆，是先前的一倍还多
facts.anchor: There were seven now, more than double

facts.fact: Kay 在车上问叙述者，家族疏离是不是她的亲身经历
facts.anchor: Do you know it from personal experience?

facts.fact: 来电的 Joe 是验尸官，Kay 用口型把身份告诉叙述者
facts.anchor: Medical examiner, she mouthed to me.

facts.fact: Joe 给的死亡时间窗是检验前四到十二小时，即昨晚七点到凌晨三点
facts.anchor: seven last night till three in the morning

facts.fact: 胃里是几乎没消化的汉堡和薯条，外加大量芬太尼
facts.anchor: She had a burger and fries, mainly undigested

facts.fact: 尸检在她腹部发现一道勒痕，且只出现在身前，不绕一整圈
facts.anchor: There’s a welt on her midsection.

facts.fact: Joe 发现腰部那道痕后反复核过，脚踝与手腕上没有别的痕迹
facts.anchor: I triple-checked, once I found the one around the waist.
